newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Unilever rally gaining momentum.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Unilever rally gaining momentum.

text.p: DAY'S RANGE * SUPPORT * RESTNCE* RSI-14* MA-25 * MA-50
+ Shares in Unilever Plc look set to surpass January 26 record peak at 1379p, technical analysts said.
+ Rally gained momentum after forming bullish "golden cross." Relative strength indicators point to further gains.
+ Initial resistance seen at 1380p; support at 1300p.
+ Advance seen extending to at least 1500p, with potential to rise as high as 1758p over nine-month period.
Shares in Anglo-Dutch consumer products group Unilever Plc, up to their highest level in more than seven months, look set to surpass their record peak at 1379p, technical analysts said.
By 1032 GMT, the shares were up 15-1/2p to 1338-1/2p.
The rally gained momentum as the charts formed a bullish cross formation last week, said Robin Griffiths, a technical analyst with HSBC James Capel.
"This is the start of a big move," said Griffiths, who predicts the shares will rise to at least 1500p.
Over the short-term, Griffiths said, momentum indicators suggest a quick move above its record high at 1379p.
The advance, he added, has the potential to rise 50 percent from the April lows to 1758p over a nine-month period.
"We're looking for quantum leaps," said Griffiths. "As long as they don't retrace too much. If they fell below 1300p, that would be a worry, but I don't think they will."
The shares set a record on January 24 and then stumbled for three months, until bottoming out in mid-April. The shares have been climbing since.

Shares in Unilever jumped sharply last week following reports that the company's new co-chairman plans to restructure Unilever's wide-ranging spread of worldwide businesses to enhance shareholder value.
Natwest Securities, in turn, added Unilever to its top 15 list of selected stocks last week, boosting Unilever shares further.
